<function name="GetDrawColumn" parent="DMenu" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether the <page>DMenu</page> should draw the icon column with a different color or not.

See <page>DMenu:SetDrawColumn</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether to draw the column or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
